name: Arbitrate Strategic Plans — Additive vs Destructive
description: Choose between Plan A (zero-downtime additive migration) and Plan B (destructive drop-and-recreate) to implement schema migration.

inputs.task_prompt: Read plans/plan-a.json and plans/plan-b.json. Implement migrateData(rows: any[]) in src/migrator.ts following the non-destructive strategy in plan-a (preserving existing columns while adding formatted displayName). Ensure test/migrator.test.ts passes.
